description: PostgreSQL 18 exact numeric typmods, rounding, arithmetic, special values, ordering, aggregates, and errors
sql: SELECT 1.235::numeric(4,2) AS positive_round, (-1.235)::numeric(4,2) AS negative_round, 149::numeric(2,-1) AS negative_scale, 0.001234::numeric(2,4) AS scale_above_precision, 1.2300e2::numeric AS exponent_input;

SELECT 1.20::numeric + 2.3::numeric AS addition, 1.20::numeric - 2.3::numeric AS subtraction, 1.20::numeric * 2.30::numeric AS multiplication, 1.00::numeric / 3::numeric AS division, 5.50::numeric % 2::numeric AS modulo;

SELECT 'NaN'::numeric = 'NaN'::numeric AS nan_equal, 'NaN'::numeric > 'Infinity'::numeric AS nan_above_infinity, 'Infinity'::numeric + '-Infinity'::numeric AS opposite_infinities, 'Infinity'::numeric * 0::numeric AS infinity_times_zero, 2::numeric % 'Infinity'::numeric AS finite_mod_infinity;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_exact_numeric (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, amount NUMERIC(8,2), rounded NUMERIC(2,-1), flexible NUMERIC);
SELECT id, amount, rounded, flexible FROM type_matrix_exact_numeric ORDER BY flexible, id;
SELECT SUM(amount) AS amount_sum, AVG(amount) AS amount_avg, MIN(flexible) AS flexible_min, MAX(flexible) AS flexible_max FROM type_matrix_exact_numeric;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_exact_numeric WHERE flexible = 0.1::numeric ORDER BY id;
